away.summary: The Canadiens open the season with a 0-0-0 record, relying on a projected lineup that includes Jakub Dobes as the starting goaltender. Key absences include injured defenseman Kaiden Guhle (adductor) and forward Oliver Kapanen (lower body), along with scratched players Florian Xhekaj and Adam Engstrom. The team recently assigned ten players to the Laval Rocket and placed nine others on waivers for AHL loan.

doubtful.detail: Participation uncertain pending immigration status resolution

home.summary: The Maple Leafs also begin the season at 0-0-0, with Sergei Bobrovsky projected to start in goal. The lineup features rookie Gavin McKenna on his NHL debut, while Max Domi and Dakota Joshua are injured. Kirill Marchenko's status is uncertain due to immigration processing. The team recently signed Nick Blankenburg, though he is scratched for this game.
